name: Eurite
oneLiner: EURI is Banking Circle's MiCA-licensed euro stablecoin, issued by a Luxembourg credit institution with fee-free 1:1 redemption against segregated euro reserves.
collateral: Euro cash and low-risk liquid assets held in segregated fiduciary accounts, bankruptcy-remote from Banking Circle S.A.
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption at par (fee-free) by Banking Circle S.A.

references.label: ESMA MiCA interim register – EMT issuers (EMTWP.csv, Banking Circle S.A. entry, whitepaper date 28/08/2024)
Banking Circle regulatory information (credit institution, LEI 213800W1NGBLERUS6M39, LUB00000408)
Paperjam: Banking Circle first to hold banking, EMT and CASP licences in Luxembourg (CASP effective 15 April 2026)

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: EURI resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: EURI is issuer-minted/redeemed by Banking Circle; Ethereum owner reads resolve to an EOA while the EIP-1967 proxy admin is a contract whose owner resolves to an EOA.

controls.label: Banking Circle issuer-operated mint authority
controls.evidence: Banking Circle materials identify EURI as an issuer-managed MiCA EMT issued on Ethereum and BSC.

controls.label: EURI Ethereum token owner
controls.evidence: owner() returned this address at Ethereum block 25166591; code read returned no contract bytecode.

controls.label: EURI EIP-1967 proxy admin
controls.evidence: EIP-1967 admin slot returned this address in a 2026-05-25 Ethereum RPC read; code size was nonzero and owner() returned EOA 0x315ef9e4fECf88B7cFc860d7E995Ff72aD7c7A21.

review.evidence: Issuer materials and direct Ethereum reads identify Banking Circle's issuer route, token owner, and proxy-admin path. A 2026-05-25 Ethereum RPC read corrected the proxy-admin classification from no-code EOA to contract-owned admin.
unresolvedQuestions: Review BSC deployment roles before extending this to all EURI chains.
